courses.note: Elective, not required: the major requires one course from a list of AI, networking, cybersecurity and robotics courses (CSCE 336 ... 479). CSCE 478 was taught Fall 2023 and Spring 2025 (instructor page), so chosen as the most frequently offered intro ML/AI course; CSCE 476 Intro to AI is the alternative (only a Spring 2009 syllabus found). Newest public material is a Fall 2014 course announcement, pre-ChatGPT; no 2023+ syllabus found.
